detail: Full summary: file-backend index backfill claim in spec §5 is false: only DecisionStore.create() writes full index entries (updateStatus/linkCommit patch single fields), so 'populated on next write' never happens for existing decisions; measured full-record read cost is ~3.3ms for 170 decisions (~45ms extrapolated to the 2,180-decision field store) — pure Option C is likely sufficient
